summary: Siskiyou County lookout built 1933 for the Shasta NF on a 20-foot enclosed tower; removed before 1986, only the foundation remains.

notes_for_editor: Two sources only. No removal year is documented beyond 'before 1986', so no removal event is recorded. The Reddit post on the foundation could not be read (the fetch returned only the site name), so it is not used. No current access statement found. The 1959 entry names the staffer; the story omits her name. Used two web searches and four page reads.
